grading_applied.rationale: 2 P1s fall within C threshold (max 2), but 16 P2s exceed C threshold (max 15). Falls to D.

escalations.title: Handlebars RCE via AST Type Confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: Malicious PR includes crafted test template; npm test triggers RCE on CI runner
escalations.impact: Remote code execution on developer machines and CI/CD pipeline
escalations.escalation_reason: RCE vulnerability in test infrastructure — requires security review before merge

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not registered in app.ts — DependencyPicker broken
p1_findings.description: Cross-entity typeahead endpoint missing from all route files and not registered in app.ts. DependencyPicker UI is completely non-functional.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts; implement GET /api/search?q= filtering store by title/description; register in app.ts.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers directly import workItemStore — architecture violation
p2_findings.description: Three route files import workItemStore directly, bypassing the service layer. CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers.'
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts; route handlers call service; service calls store.

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 metrics; 3 counters present, Histogram class not imported and histogram absent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Histogram import and dependencyCheckDuration histogram with appropriate buckets.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer regex blind to FR-dependency-* IDs
p2_findings.description: Pattern FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ silently skips all lowercase FR IDs. All 16 FR-dependency-* IDs are invisible to the enforcer.
p2_findings.recommendation: Change to FR-[A-Za-z0-9-]+. One-line fix restores coverage for all dependency FRs.

p2_findings.title: Logger always emits JSON — no development pretty-printing
p2_findings.description: CLAUDE.md: 'structured JSON in production, pretty-printing in development.' The emit() function has no NODE_ENV check.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV === 'development' branch in emit() that calls console.log for pretty output.

p2_findings.title: Express qs dependency DoS vulnerability
p2_findings.description: qs.stringify() crashes with TypeError on null entries in comma-format arrays. Remotely triggerable DoS.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion ReDoS via zero-step sequences
p2_findings.description: Zero-step sequences (e.g., {0..0..0}) cause infinite loops and process hang.

p2_findings.title: uuid buffer bounds check missing in v3/v5/v6
p2_findings.description: Buffer overflow when custom buf parameter smaller than 16 bytes passed to uuid v3/v5/v6.
p2_findings.fix: Audit for uuid.v3/v5/v6 with buf args; upgrade to uuid@>=11.1.1 or document as v4-only safe.

p2_findings.title: Vite path traversal in .map file handling
p2_findings.description: Path traversal vulnerability in Vite dev server source map handling.

p2_findings.title: esbuild dev server CORS bypass
p2_findings.description: esbuild development server CORS headers bypass allows cross-origin requests.
p2_findings.fix: Resolved by updating vite (pulls updated esbuild).

p2_findings.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS output
p2_findings.description: PostCSS does not escape </style> sequences in CSS output, enabling XSS injection in style tags.

p2_findings.title: ws WebSocket uninitialized memory disclosure
p2_findings.description: Uninitialized memory can be disclosed in certain WebSocket protocol conditions.

p2_findings.title: vitest multiple CVEs via vite/esbuild transitive dependencies
p2_findings.description: Inherits vite path traversal and esbuild CORS issues through transitive deps.

p2_findings.title: @vitest/mocker inherits vite vulnerabilities
p2_findings.description: Inherits vite issues. Resolved by vitest upgrade.

p3_findings.title: In-memory store has no file persistence (FR-WF-001 gap)
p3_findings.description: FR-WF-001 acceptance criteria requires 'CRUD operations on in-memory store with file persistence.' Store is plain Map; state lost on restart.
p3_findings.recommendation: Serialize to .data/workItems.json on write; hydrate on startup.

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed not implemented
p3_findings.description: No seed.ts exists. DependencySection has nothing useful to display on fresh install.
p3_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/store/seed.ts; call idempotently from app.ts.

p3_findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md is a dormant 69-FR spec (0% coverage)
p3_findings.description: Project pivoted; 69 FRs describe an unbuilt product. Misleads agents reading Specifications/.
p3_findings.recommendation: Add ARCHIVED status banner or move to docs/archive/.

p3_findings.title: Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md targets wrong portal/ paths
p3_findings.description: All file paths reference portal/ which no longer exists; implementation is under Source/. Delta table is stale.
p3_findings.recommendation: Update all portal/ references to Source/ equivalents; refresh delta table.

p4_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressing react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
p4_findings.description: Two eslint-disable-next-line suppressions masking potential stale closure bugs.
p4_findings.recommendation: Fix hook dependency arrays; use useCallback for stable refs.

p4_findings.title: Dual logger abstraction — logger.ts wraps utils/logger.ts
p4_findings.description: Two logger files with different calling conventions used inconsistently across codebase.
p4_findings.recommendation: Standardize on one convention; eliminate the wrapper shim.

cross_references.single_fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite vitest
